body.x: PURE IMAGINATION(www.perfectbakeapp.com) introduced "Perfect Bake" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Perfect Bake simplified the baking process and differentiated the stages of baking by the color of the plates to be used for each stage. Users can refer to the recipes provided in the free app, and can also edit the recipes to add more variety. There is also a timer for easier and more accurate mixing and baking.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
